title: Vault Dweller in Ruined Arcade
description: A woman in a red Vault-Tec jumpsuit stands in a dilapidated retro-futuristic arcade, holding a glowing Pip-Boy that emits blue holographic particles. The decaying two-story room features broken floor tiles, scattered Nuka-Cola posters, large gears on the walls, and a massive mural of a nuclear explosion with silhouetted falling figures on the upper level.
